contract: search_covers streams a provider cover search to the requesting socket: any authenticated user may search, the payload is {requestId, title, author, provider, podcast}; a socket without a user is answered cover_search_error {requestId, error 'Unauthorized'}; a payload without requestId or title is answered cover_search_error error 'Invalid request parameters' carrying the requestId only when the payload defined one; a valid search emits cover_search_result {requestId, provider, covers, total} per provider batch before cover_search_complete {requestId} and nothing else; a custom metadata provider (provider 'custom-<id>') is queried with mediaType=book&query=<title>&author=<author> and its answer's covers are streamed; an answer without covers completes without result events; concurrent searches are separated by requestId.
exceptions: Named tests are assertion leads, not complete coverage or a current execution claim. Missing source/client state and failure variants remain required.
force is not applicable: search_covers has no force or override mode.

search_covers with no payload at all kills the server with an unhandled rejection that calls process.exit(1) (server/SocketAuthority.js:379, server/Server.js:246-251); no real client sends it, so it is not asserted.

search_covers with no payload at all fails upstream with an unhandled exception before emitting anything (server/SocketAuthority.js:379 reads payload.requestId); no real client sends it, so the scenario asserts only that no event is emitted.
Cancelling another user's active search is not asserted (no ownership check in CoverSearchManager.cancelSearch): no known client offers a cross-user cancellation.

invariants.contract: search_covers streams a provider cover search to the requesting socket: any authenticated user may search; an unauthenticated socket gets cover_search_error {requestId, error 'Unauthorized'} and starts no search; a payload without requestId or title gets cover_search_error 'Invalid request parameters' with the requestId carried only when defined; a valid custom-provider search streams cover_search_result {requestId, provider: 'custom-<id>', covers, total} before cover_search_complete {requestId}, queries the provider with mediaType=book&query=<title>&author=<author>, completes without errors when the answer has no covers, and keeps concurrent searches separate by requestId.
